title_draft: How Long Is Zad Archery? Main Run and 100% Estimate
quick_answer_draft: Plan on about five hours for a normal run. The developer described Zad Archery as designed around ~5 hours, while launch-day players reported finishing or maxing major systems in roughly 4–5.5 hours. 100% completion can take longer because build choices, loot and achievements affect the run.

claims.text: Before launch, Samharia Studios said the game was designed to take around five hours.
The developer specifically noted that build choices and loot affect duration, especially for players pursuing 100% achievements.
One Reddit player reported reaching Level 40, defeating the final boss and maxing almost every system in about 5.5 hours.
Another launch-day comment reported maxing out in about four hours.

sections.h2: What can make your run longer?

claims.text: Loot and build choices are explicitly named by the developer as factors that change completion time.
Achievement hunting should be treated separately from the main run because the live achievement list includes milestones such as Level 40, Legendary Gear and defeating the King.

media_slots.capture_target: late-game or Level 40 screen if available

faq.q: Can Zad Archery be finished in one sitting?
faq.a: Yes. The official target is roughly five hours, and multiple launch-day reports fall around four to five and a half hours.
There is not enough reliable post-launch timing data yet. The developer only said achievement hunting can extend the run.
